draft.title: Distortions of taste
card: Supertaster
a person with many taste buds, who tastes bitter and other strong flavours more intensely than most people do.
Miracle berry
a fruit with a protein that changes how sour foods taste. For a short time, a lemon tastes sweet, though the lemon itself has not changed.
Food colour
colour changes the flavours people report. A drink dyed red may be said to taste of strawberry or cherry, even when the flavour is the same as an uncoloured drink.
In each case the taste is not just the food itself. The person's receptors and the cues from sight shape what they report.
draft.remember: Taste can be distorted by the person's receptors, by a chemical change, or by what the eyes see.

a.q: Two students eat the same lemon after chewing a miracle berry. One says it tastes sweet. What best explains this?
opts: The berry changed how the sour taste was sensed
The lemon had less acid than a normal lemon
The student has more taste buds than most people
The lemon's colour changed what flavour was reported
a.why: The miracle berry protein changes how sour foods taste for a short time, while the lemon stays the same. Having many taste buds describes a supertaster, who tastes more strongly, not one who finds sour food sweet.
a.clue: The lemon itself did not change. Think about what the berry does.

b.q: Ravi gives two clear drinks with identical flavour to his friends. He dyes one green and leaves the other uncoloured. Most friends say the green drink tastes of lime. What does this show?
opts: Colour can change the flavours people report
Ravi's friends are all supertasters
The green dye made the drink taste sour
Colour has no effect on taste in most people
b.why: The flavour was identical, yet the colour changed what people reported, so sight shaped their taste. Being a supertaster is about tasting more intensely, which would not explain why one drink got a lime report and the other did not.
b.clue: Only one thing differed between the two drinks.

a.best: The berry changed how the sour taste was sensed

b.best: Colour can change the flavours people report
